title: Raising Cane's Coming Soon to the Third Street Promenade
description:
Coming Soon to the Third Street Promenade 🌴
The city of Santa Monica met with the Raising Cane’s team and developers for a sneak peek of the new location coming to the Third Street Promenade.

Stay tuned for updates!
transcript_text: I've liked Santa Monica like this from the first time out here, and then taking my kids over the years and riding the roller coasters and enjoying the whole bit. We like a common out. Hello everyone, my name is James Cook. I'm the area leader for Raising Cane's. This is actually going to be our first location inside of Santa Monica, and what better place to put it in the iconic Third Street Promenade. >> I love to do these iconic locations where tourists come and they can try Raising Cane's. We went on the edge so we could have that corner location. We got a really neat design. It matches the boardwalk. It's a nod to the boardwalks at there. It's going to be a unique Raising Cane's that we've ever had and a water feature abstract design to where you really nod to the area. Almost 30 years later and we're still serving the same box combo, the same sweet tea we did it from day one. But beyond the food, we're also very active in the community to support local events and schools. Come and see us at Santa Monica. One love.
